message: Hi, my little one Rio is 5 and wants to try jiu jitsu. Do you have classes for that age?

Hey! Yes, we do have Kids Jiu-Jitsu classes for 5-year-olds. Rio would be a great fit! We offer a free trial class so they can try it out and see if they love it. Would you like to get that scheduled?
Yes, that sounds great! When is the next available time for the trial class?
Perfect! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?

Great, thajks Tester! And what's the best email for you?
*thanks
Perfect! And is this the best number to reach you, or would you prefer a different one?
Yes, this is the best number: 860-555-0620.
Great! Now I just need Rio's full name and date of birth to get the trial class booked. What's Rio's full name?
Rio's full name is Rio Raven, and his birthday is February 14, 2021.

Perfect! Rio is all set for the Kids Jiu-Jitsu class. I have a couple spots available this week:

Wednesday, July 8 at 3:45 PM
Monday, July 13 at 3:45 PM

Which works better for you?
Let's go with Wednesday, July 8 at 3:45 PM. Thank you!
Perfect! Rio is all booked for Wednesday, July 8 at 3:45 PM. We're at 640 Merrimon Ave, Suite 201 in Asheville. Just bring comfortable clothes and he's good to go. See you both then!
